rationale: The papers (2510.14026, 2602.23147, and s2:On the Possibility of an Upper Limit on Magnetically Induced Radius Inflation in Low-mass Stars) investigate the effects of magnetic activity on stellar radii, which is central to understanding the discrepancies in observed radii and temperatures of K-type stars in binary systems.
